title: A prohibition naming the held-out folder, with no exposure, is a recorded breach without remedy
situation: After 0095, one builder brief said never to open the judgment folders, keeping the builder away by instruction rather than omission; the lead checked that builder's record and found no held-out text reached it, only file names in one listing. An assayer rejected judgment 4 on it.
decision: It stands as a recorded process breach with no exposure: no held-out case is replaced, because none was seen. The remedy is the one 0095 already makes: no brief names the held-out examples or where they live. The assayers judge the cut on this record.
consequences: Judgment 4 is re-run once the recording sweep lands.
